name: omnipaint-bench
description: A benchmark for image painting and conditional image generation/editing from multimodal inputs (e.g., prompts, masks). It measures a model's ability to produce coherent, high-fidelity image edits or full generations that match conditioning cues. Evaluation emphasizes visual quality, faithfulness to the prompt, and preservation of specified structure.
reputation: A specialized benchmark with modest adoption in research on image editing/generation, primarily used by groups working on controllable image synthesis.
